rationale: Sized against the event, not the 0.219-per-revision rate: one grammar widening cost 112 records, 22 percent of the old bound, in a single commit. 896 holds today's 469 plus one such widening plus 400 revisions of steady growth at 74.6 percent, below the warning band, and leaves 128 of the portable 1024 cap as reserve rather than consuming it. max_bytes moves with it so the record bound stays binding: at the measured 368-byte mean, 262144 would have bound at about 712 records.
